description: This file contains utility string functions such as case-insensitive search, comparison, trimming, case conversion, base64 encoding, and whitespace removal, encapsulated within the Utils::String namespace.

classes.name: loc_equal
classes.description: A template struct for locale-aware character equality comparison.

methods.name: find_substr_ci
methods.description: Performs a case-insensitive search for a substring within a string.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a string contains a given substring, case-insensitive.

methods.name: equal
methods.description: Performs a case-insensitive comparison of two strings.

methods.name: ltrim
methods.description: Removes leading whitespace characters from a string.

methods.name: rtrim
methods.description: Removes trailing whitespace characters from a string.

methods.name: trim
methods.description: Removes whitespace from both ends of a string.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits a string into a vector of substrings based on delimiters.

methods.name: imageEncoder
methods.description: Encodes binary data into a base64 string.

methods.name: removeExtraWhitespaces
methods.description: Removes extra spaces from an input string.
